skills.title: Soft Skills

ux.organization: Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Faculty of Computer Science UNEJ
highlights: Oversee research initiatives and academic practicums, applying structured research methodologies to laboratory projects.
Lead a team of assistants, coordinating research workflows and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Facilitated learning sessions for 50 students, developing clear instructional frameworks to improve knowledge transfer and comprehension.
Applied user-centered communication strategies to adapt technical content to varied learning needs.

ux.organization: International Conference on Technical and Vocational Education and Training (ICTVET)
highlights: Presented research findings on technology and vocational education advancements to an audience of 200+ attendees.
Developed a structured narrative to communicate complex research insights clearly and persuasively.
Lead the HRD division, designing people-centered programs to develop member capabilities and community impact.
Identified community needs and developed targeted educational programs to bridge the gap between students and higher education access.
Coordinated cross-functional teams and managed documentation, ensuring structured and efficient event operations.
Lead a 50+ member community, designing programs that translate academic goals into actionable engagement strategies.
Crafted and disseminated clear, audience-appropriate communications to the IT student community.

portfolio.title: Trashtopia – Gamified Waste Management App
portfolio.description: Investigated low public motivation in daily waste sorting through qualitative research and behavioral analysis, synthesizing findings into UX writing and gamified mechanics (Adventure & Arena).

portfolio.title: GESIT – Smart City Application
portfolio.description: Mapped urban community needs around public service accessibility (waste management & donor tracking) into user flows, microcopy, and information architecture.

portfolio.title: Coulture – Culture & Travel Exploration App
portfolio.description: Examined post-pandemic tourist information-seeking behaviors through market research and synthesized findings into user journey maps and UX writing guidelines.

portfolio.title: Trans Jogja Smart Tourism Recommender
portfolio.description: Analyzed tourist navigation pain points in Yogyakarta's public transit network and applied CRISP-DM to build an intuitive, map-based route recommendation prototype.

portfolio.title: Booktopia – E-Commerce & Literature Platform
portfolio.description: Analyzed transaction and catalog browsing flows to remove friction, integrating AJAX and user-informed backend architecture to earn the highest academic grade.

portfolio.title: Website PKM-PI GK JEMBER
portfolio.description: Digital marketing optimization with Augmented Reality web visualization to elevate promotional creativity for MSME Gerai Anyaman Plastik Desa Sidorejo.
